label: Underived necessary concretum, from necessity, no contingent support and coverage
description: An alternative to the stage-one join NecessaryConcreteUnderivedFromNecessity.underived that replaces reflexive access and J2 (well-founded cross-world union) by well-founded actual grounding at w and coverage. From a necessary concretum, descend actual grounding among concreta existing at w and necessary from w: a supporter of such a concretum at any admitted world gives, by coverage, a concrete supporter existing at w, which J1 (used only at w) makes necessary, so a minimal one has no existing concrete supporter at any admitted world. The witness may differ from the given necessary concretum. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
